experiments.title: Final validation only
experiments.hypothesis: Skipping intermediate validation keeps final loss and measured train_time comparable while reducing real wall-clock cost for future iterations.
experiments.command: VARIANT_ID=final_validation_only REPLACEMENTS_JSON='{"val_loss_every: int = 250":"val_loss_every: int = 0"}' bash experiments/arthur/run_variant.sh

experiments.title: Remove 10 extension steps
experiments.hypothesis: The current baseline has enough loss margin to remove the 10 post-schedule extension steps and still meet val_loss <= 3.28.

experiments.title: 1370 scheduled steps without extension
experiments.hypothesis: A small reduction in scheduled iterations plus no extension may still meet the target and save 15 total training steps versus baseline.
experiments.command: VARIANT_ID=scheduled_1370_no_extension REPLACEMENTS_JSON='{"num_scheduled_iterations: int = 1375":"num_scheduled_iterations: int = 1370","num_extension_iterations: int = 10":"num_extension_iterations: int = 0"}' bash experiments/arthur/run_variant.sh
